cpu_census.mechanism: Per-stage cgroup-v2 leaf containing launcher, children, the /proc PID+start-time sampler, and audits; cpu.max one CPU.
cpu_census.sampler_location: Inside the stage leaf (its CPU counted and bounded); it also detects descendants outside the leaf.
cpu_census.final_read: After the leaf is empty, the registrar's reader runs outside it, reads cpu.stat usage_usec once, and adds its own getrusage CPU to the charge.
cpu_census.audit_deadline: Local and root audits combined run after stage publication with a hard 120 s kill; a killed audit is an operational failure.
cpu_census.unknown_tail: Descendant observed outside the cgroup, failed census read, or sampled per-process CPU exceeding the cgroup total. Reported as unknown, never excluded; blocks all later admissions.
cpu_census.unit_note: All prior figures are wall seconds; no puck process CPU has been measured.
cpu_census.availability: cgroup-v2 delegation not verified while drafting; absence blocks execution (D4).

expected_cost_table.unit_of_priors: wall seconds from single historical runs, not CPU seconds
